canonicalIngredients.name: tinned tuna
observations: 425 g chunk in olive oil, drained (s3)

canonicalIngredients.name: tinned chopped/crushed tomatoes
observations: absent - 500 g creamy tomato jar sauce instead (s0)

canonicalIngredients.name: dried Italian herbs
observations: 1 tsp dried basil as fresh-basil substitute (s1)

causalSequence: boil short pasta to just under packet time; drain
soften onion (and garlic) in olive oil, 3-5 min
add tinned tomato (+ paste, dried herbs); simmer to thicken
fold drained tuna through sauce, keeping chunks intact
toss pasta through sauce; transfer to greased baking dish
bake 180-190 C until golden and bubbling, 15-30 min
techniqueFacts: three sources fold the tuna in gently so chunks stay intact rather than shredding
sauce is thickened on the stove before baking: 20 min covered simmer (s1) vs quick 3-4 min reduction (s2)
s3 half-cooks the pasta and finishes it in the oven (25 min bake); s1 and s2 cook pasta fully first
bake temperatures cluster at 180 C fan-forced / 190 C; times range 10-15 min (jar sauce, s0) to 25-30 min covered then uncovered 5 min to crisp (s1)
tuna in olive oil is the majority pick (s0, s1, s3); the health-focused source uses springwater tuna and reduced-fat cheddar (s2)
s1 layers half the parmesan mid-dish and half on top
s0 is a jarred-sauce shortcut variant with baby spinach and pine nuts stirred through
s2 lightens the dish with peas, halved cherry tomatoes, lemon zest, rocket and wholemeal pasta, and reserves 1/3 cup pasta water for the sauce
